name: learning-coach
description: A multi-Skill learning system with Topic-local coaching, portfolio planning, read-only views, and a private GitHub-backed Learning Vault.

interface.shortDescription: Learn inside Topics and plan across your learning portfolio
interface.longDescription: Learning Coach is a multi-Skill learning system backed by a user-owned GitHub Learning Vault. Topic Coach runs Topic-local learning, Ask Coach plans across the portfolio, Learning View presents state read-only, and Vault Curator maintains the Vault. The Plugin requires the canonical GitHub app and never requires PATs or private infrastructure.
defaultPrompt: Resume one of my learning Topics and continue from the next useful step.
Based on my Learning Vault, what should I learn, review, practice, or defer next?
Show my current learning state without changing it.
